core_obligations: Reduce locally: on Y and X the morphism f factors as a regular closed immersion iota followed by a smooth morphism g of relative dimension m, with iota of codimension m-n cut out by a regular sequence (proof lines 694-695).

Compute the upper shriek: writing omega^circ_{S/Y} for the m-differentials, f^!O_Y = iota^! g^! O_Y becomes the inverse image of the derived hom of the quotient sheaf against those differentials, shifted by m (proof lines 696-700).

Replace the resolution: the Koszul complex of the regular sequence is a flat resolution of the quotient and its dual resolves the quotient shifted by the codimension, which turns the derived hom into a tensor product (proof lines 701-705).
Conclude: the resulting object is the inverse image of the restriction of omega^circ_{S/Y}, shifted by n, which is an invertible sheaf of O_X-modules (proof lines 705-708).
proof_roadmap: Factor the morphism locally into a smooth map and a regular closed immersion and write down the resulting expression for the upper shriek (proof lines 694-700).
Use the Koszul resolution and its dual to evaluate the derived hom, and read off invertibility (proof lines 701-708).
difficulty_reason: The lemma computes the upper shriek of the structure sheaf along an lci morphism of relative dimension n between locally noetherian schemes of finite Krull dimension, showing it is the shift by n of an invertible sheaf (statement lines 689-692). The proof factors the morphism locally into a regular closed immersion followed by a smooth morphism, writes the upper shriek as the inverse image of a derived hom against the sheaf of m-differentials, and then replaces that derived hom by an explicit Koszul computation: the Koszul complex of the defining regular sequence is a flat resolution and its dual resolves the quotient shifted by the codimension (proof lines 694-707). The step that carries the content is the passage from the derived hom to the tensor product through the Koszul resolution, since it is what identifies the answer with the restriction of an invertible sheaf; the local factorization and the shift bookkeeping are then immediate. H2.
